Got it, Bettina. From now on I'll write every date to you as day, three-letter month, year, with dashes. For example, today's message date is 14-Oct-2026. I won't use the 2026-10-14 or 14.10.2026 styles with you.

This applies only to our conversations. It won't change how I write dates for anyone else.
